# graphiant_playbook_bundles (Data Source)

Automation Workflows catalog bundles (System, Network, Routing, ...). A bundle's key is the bundle_key used by graphiant_playbook_config and the module-slot/template data sources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "graphiant_playbook_bundles" "all" {}
```
